hypothesis: The defect is that positional-v0 associates results[i] with articles[i] by array position, which fails when the model returns a different count or reorders results. This keyed-v2 parser associates results to articles by matching article_id fields, refusing when counts mismatch, IDs are duplicate/missing/unknown, or scores are invalid. This prevents silent misassociation.
